image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) displayed against a neutral beige wall. The armor features a central vertical ridge, curved lateral panels mimicking pectoral muscles, and visible rivets near the top edge. The surface is highly reflective with specular highlights indicating a smooth metal texture. The bottom edge shows a slight flare (fauld), and the top edge is curved to fit under the arms.
